description: Keep this exact otter, pose, silhouette, colors and teal backpack, but add more fine detail: individual fur strand clusters along the body, whisker dots and a small nose highlight, a tiny eye highlight, clearly shaded webbed paws with toe lines, backpack straps with buckle and stitching, darker underbelly shading and a lit rim on the head and back, textured tail with scale-like shading. Clean dark navy 1px outline, dithered shading, limited palette, no gradients, no anti-aliasing.
